title: Universal Life Insurance Conversion Endorsement: Term Life Insurance Conversion Credit on the Full-Surrender Charge
content:
**Endorsement.** On a full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy issued by converting an Ashgrove term policy (Term Life Insurance), a conversion credit reduces the surrender charge. The credit follows the Ashgrove term policy this policy was converted from: the policy record names the converted term policy, and the Term Life Insurance policy record shows it as converted with its own issue date.

**Credit scale.** The term policy's years in force are the whole years from its issue date to this policy's issue date.

| Converted Ashgrove term policy | Years in force before this policy's issue date | Conversion credit |
|---|---|---|
| Recorded, shown as converted | **5** or more (the long-term years) | Long conversion credit, **50%** (0.50) |
| Recorded, shown as converted | At least 1, fewer than 5 | Short conversion credit, **25%** (0.25) |
| Recorded, shown as converted | Less than 1 | No credit |
| None recorded | not applicable | No credit |

**Effect.** The charge is multiplied by one less the credit, by 0.50 with the long credit and by 0.75 with the short credit, before the charge is rounded to the cent.

**Hypothetical cases.**

| Term policy issue date | This policy's issue date | Whole years | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April 2015 | 1 April 2020 | 5 | 50% |
| 2 April 2015 | 1 April 2020 | 4 | 25% |
| 1 April 2019 | 1 April 2020 | 1 | 25% |
| 2 April 2019 | 1 April 2020 | 0 | None |

A policy issued on a new application, with no converted term policy recorded, earns no conversion credit.
